name: Barbell Overhead Press
summary: A standing barbell press that builds shoulder and triceps strength while training core stability.
setup: Set the bar at upper chest height in a rack and grip just outside shoulder width.
Unrack with the bar resting on the front shoulders, elbows slightly in front of the bar.
Stand with feet about hip width, squeeze glutes and brace abs.
execution: Press the bar straight up, moving your head slightly back then forward through as the bar passes the forehead.
Lock out with the bar over the middle of the foot, ribs down.
Lower under control back to the shoulders.
mistakes: Excessive lean-back and lower-back arch: squeeze glutes and brace the abs.
Bar drifting forward: keep a vertical forearm and move the head out of the way.
Flared ribs: keep them stacked over the pelvis.
Pressing from a bouncing start: reset on the shoulders each rep.
